title: Aromatic Crunchy Peruvian Pumpkin Seeds Dumplings
description: Nutty, crisp dumplings packed with toasted pumpkin seeds and quinoa, a flavorful hangover cure inspired by Peruvian street food.
instructions: Toast pumpkin seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk quinoa flour, salt, pepper, garlic powder, cumin, coriander, and lime zest together.
Stir in water until a sticky dough forms.
Fold in toasted pumpkin seeds, cilantro, and soy sauce if using.
Cover the dough and let it rest for 10 minutes at room temperature.
On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough into small 2-inch rounds, then cut into 1-inch pieces.
Place each piece into a steamer basket and steam over simmering water for 6 minutes until firm.
Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and pan-fry the steamed dumplings until golden brown and crisp on each side, about 3 minutes per side.
Serve hot with a squeeze of fresh lime and a sprinkle of extra pumpkin seeds for crunch.
